visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair and bangs, wearing a beige ribbed long-sleeve top and a black choker with a 'CHOKER' charm, stands indoors in front of a white door and speaks to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of her face as she points to her cheek to illustrate skin texture, followed by a transition to photos of her in a makeup studio setting with pigtails and a blazer. (3) Close-up shots show makeup shine and oiliness on her skin, interspersed with a humorous clip of a movie character with heavy white face paint. (4) The visual focus shifts to her lips where she demonstrates overlining techniques using red lipstick, with arrows indicating specific areas of application. (5) Screenshots of online makeup tutorials and photos of the creator with heavy nose shadows are shown to illustrate common contouring errors that look 'dirty' in person. (6) High-granularity close-ups of her eyes compare thick versus thin eyeliner, showing how thick lines can make eyelids appear heavy. (7) The video concludes with the creator back in the original setting, gesturing toward the viewer while wrapping up her advice.

(7) [Variety]: 1 水光肌底妝. (8) [Subtitle]: 你有沒有發現畫完. (9) [Subtitle]: 水光肌的明星. (10) [Subtitle]: 只能夠拍固定的角度. (11) [Subtitle]: 或者是需要打光. (12) [Subtitle]: 因為它是非常吃角度跟光線. (13) [Subtitle]: 在生活裡面.
